CHANGES

+ The card 'Anger Fairy' is now an uncommon card and its damage increases with 'Strategy' and 'Apocalypse';

notes.title: Save Your Run!
notes.content:
NEW


+ New Dragon: Sagittarius Dragon.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/06a2f69592ea7c4d4b837e4da514374a4f5f4de3.png"]

+ Save Run System: You can now save your run by clicking "quit" in the pause menu to continue later.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/e5d07a2630d53c52efb803a06cf935b81c9612e6.png"]

+ Card Information: You can now view information about your card stacks in the pause menu by hovering over them.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/dcc0e3798e525ea06303da407528eece28a1b946.png"]
CHANGES


+ The "TAURUS" dragon has had its ability reworked: now, pressing 'J' allows you to dash toward the target, attacking it with a horn attack and gaining a temporary shield that blocks melee and projectile attacks. It can no longer obtain 'SWIFTNESS' cards, but its dash now extends much further and receives a 90% damage reduction while dashing.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/8b4a557449ad536b6136a6871add9e39be77beb1.png"]

+ The epic card "COLOSSUS" now also instantly grants +1600 max HP.


BALANCE


+ The burning of fire environment now deals increasing damage as the waves progress; 

+ Fire and Ice bosses' special attacks now reach the sky, making the battle more challenging, even if the player is flying;

+ The 'SWIFTNESS' card has been nerfed: it now reduces the dash cooldown by 0.4 sec instead of 0.5.

notes.title: Basic Attacks Upgrade
notes.content:
Changes


+ New difficulty progression system: Enemies now start easier, not just weaker, and as waves progress, enemies become harder, not just stronger. This difficulty is reflected in aspects like casting speed, movement speed, accuracy, etc;

+ The basic attack upgrade system has been improved: now, each level of the basic attack makes a much bigger difference:

Ball: Significantly increases damage with each level

Beam: Increases size with each level

Missile: Launches 1 extra missile with each level

Blast: +10% range and +25% chance to launch an extra burst with each level

Rock: +100% explosion area with each level

+ The epic card "Ravenous Blows" has been changed: now your basic attacks are cast in bursts of 2 instead of 1;

+ Fire Intrinsic "Ignite" has been improved: now deals extra damage equivalent to 2% of target's max HP.

notes.title: Up and Down!
notes.content:
CARDS


"EPIC" cards are now called "UNIQUE", to emphasize that they can only be obtained once.

"LEGENDARY" cards are now called "EPIC".

The epic card "HEART EATER" is now obtained by stacking 6 "VAMPIRIC POWER" instead of 8 "STRONG HEART".

Two new cards have been ADDED to the game:

(Uncommon) IMPOSING WINGS

EFFECT: Increases your ascent and descent speed.

(Epic) COLOSSUS

CONDITION: Stack 8 "STRONG HEARTS".

EFFECT: Upon landing, deals AOE damage based on your max HP and the max height reached during flight.


CHANGES


The falling system when running out of stamina has been changed:

New animations for the character falling and landing;

The character now falls much faster, allowing the player to reach the ground faster and return to combat in time. This also greatly helps with the use of the COLOSSUS card.

Enemy projectiles have been simplified in their visual effects, reducing visual clutter in waves with many projectiles.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/d92a58bd8b0ebe4fe6173152c8111049622075f8.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/dfd0c9bd0c9d24790fc64ebf0d071271c13fb83b.png"]


DRAGONS


We're introducing a new dragon selection interface, allowing for a more fluid and faster selection when choosing and managing your dragons.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/7392925df3680845ae311f1f7583c87675a6df2e.png"]

Dashes no longer cost stamina, but now have a 3-second cooldown. "Swiftness" card now reduces the cooldown of dashes by 0.5 seconds (max of 4 cards, totaling a 2-second reduction).

notes.title: New Feature: Dashes!
notes.content:
NEW: Dash!
It is now possible to perform a DASH by pressing J!

Dashes cost stamina.
New card
The uncommon card "SWIFTNESS" has been added, which reduces the stamina cost of dashing and increases the distance traveled when dashing.
Balance Adjustments
Enemies have been nerfed (less HP and less damage), so that the player can have an easier start.

The burning effect of the fire environment has been nerfed in the first waves and buffed in more distant waves, aiming to keep up with the player's development.

The intrinsic passives of the WIND and EARTH elements have been nerfed:

WIND: now has a limit of 100 stacks;

EARTH: now has a limit of 20 stacks per enemy.

notes.title: 1.31.4 Update
notes.content: + Fixed bug where you couldn't cast active skills while walking and casting auto attacks.

notes.title: Automatic Basic Attacks!
notes.content:
Automatic Basic Attacks

+ Basic attacks are now cast automatically.

+ Multiple basic attacks can be cast at the same time.

+ Basic attacks provide a button relief for the player, allowing them to simply walk, fly, and cast active abilities when needed.

Boss Balancing

+ Bosses have been adjusted and balanced to match the player's strength level, ensuring that the fight always lasts the same amount of time, regardless of the wave's strength.

notes.title: 1.31.1 Update
notes.content:
BALANCING

+ The game has been completely rebalanced so that the player has a calmer start, while becoming more challenging in more distant waves.

+ The "SHORT TEMPER" card has been removed from the game for balance reasons.

CHANGES

+ The "FEAR FAIRY", "WALKING FORTRESS" and "TIME WARP" cards are now part of a new card rarity: Epic.

+ Epic Cards: Colored blue, they are rarer than "Rare" cards and can only be found once, each.

+ The "DANCING STONES" skill now deals much more damage when recast against enemies.

FIXES

+ Some bugs have been fixed:
    - The recast button for the "DANCING STONES" skill has been fixed.
    - Exponential armor stack has been removed.
